generations.memory_44: Enterprise segment responds to sales-assisted CTA. Signup numbers dropped 12% but qualified leads jumped 24% and revenue was up 18%—that's the right trade-off for enterprise. Keep this tactic in the sales playbook only.

generations.memory_86: Shorter onboarding flow is a clean win. 13% completion rate improvement, users hit value 2+ days faster, and retention ticks up 3%. No downsides observed. Worth rolling out more broadly.
